proposals.evidence: Turner gives Jaunsari naī/nau, Kiunthal nɔ̈/nɔe, Marathi nahī and the nasalized Dardic family including Bashkarik nanda and Gawri nendi. The survey contracted Pahari/Bhili and Bashkarik nan/nīn forms fit those documented river-word developments. This rule excludes retained-d plains forms and multiword river expressions.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists western Pahari gaḍḍ river/stream and its suffixed gaḍḍṛī/gaḍōṛ variants under *gaḍḍa. The Jaunsari and Kullui gaḍ/gāḍ river forms belong to this regional watercourse sense, with vowel length retained; no generic pit meaning is imposed.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Gujarati gār/gārɔ prepared clay, Hindi gārā mud/mortar and explicitly Jaunsari gārā and Kotgarhi gār/garɔ mixed mud. These survey gār-/gar- forms match the plain-r mud family. Retroflex gāṛ- and aspirated ghāṛ- responses are excluded because Turner has other competing mud/thickness entries for them.
